scope: Exactly three pure graph adapter return definitions. No theorem proof values, existence or equality premise is granted.

fragments.pure_definitions:
def missingReturn (T S : Tree) (U : List Nat) : Return :=
  ⟨⟨none,(meterRestrict U T).work+(meterRestrict U S).work+8⟩,[],[],[]⟩

def forestReturn (T S : Tree) (U : List Nat) (b : Nat) (t s : Tree)
    (out : SourceForestV3.Result) : Return :=
  ⟨⟨out.value.map (fun F=>(F.length-1,F)),
      (meterRestrict U T).work+(meterRestrict U S).work+(out.value.map List.length).getD 0+12⟩,
    [⟨some t,[s],b⟩],[out.debit],out.slots⟩

source_context_lines: open RMAF Universal233 WholeSourceWork CoreWork SourceForestV3
fragments.pure_definitions:
def finish (p : Problem) (out : SourceForestV3.Result) : Charged (Option (Nat×F)) :=
  match out.value with
  | none=>⟨none,4⟩
  | some F=>let c:=additionalCostMeter p.sources F;⟨some (c.value,F),c.work+12⟩
